sessions.title: Send document with expiration period
steps: Navigate to documents page, find or upload a draft document
Open the document, add a recipient and signature field if needed
Click Send, verify expiration dropdown appears with all presets (7/14/30/60/90 days + custom)
Select a 7-day expiration, verify helper text shows 'Recipients will have 7 days to sign'
Send the document, verify success toast
sessions.notes: All presets verified: No expiration, 7/14/30/60/90 days, Custom. Helper text shows 'Recipients will have 7 days to sign after the document is sent'. Toast: 'Document sent successfully to 1 recipient'.

sessions.title: Verify expiration dropdown custom period
steps: Open send dialog on a draft document
Select 'Custom...' from expiration dropdown
Verify custom amount input and unit selector (Days/Weeks/Months) appear
Enter 2 weeks, verify helper text shows 'Recipients will have 2 weeks to sign'
Cancel dialog (don't send)
sessions.notes: Custom expiration UI verified: amount spinner defaults to 30, unit dropdown has Days/Weeks/Months. Changed to 2 Weeks, helper text correctly updated. Cancelled without sending.

sessions.title: Expired badge and filter on documents list
steps: Navigate to documents list page
Verify 'Expired' filter button exists in the status filter bar
Click 'Expired' filter button
Check if any expired documents appear (may need to create test data)
Verify expired documents show the correct 'Expired' badge styling
sessions.notes: Expired filter button exists in status bar. Clicking it shows active filter tag 'Status: Expired' with Clear all. No expired test data available so empty state shown correctly. Badge styling for expired verified via code review (workflow-status-badge.tsx has amber/orange styling for expired).

sessions.title: Re-send expired document from documents list
steps: Find an expired document in the documents list
Open the dropdown menu (three dots) on the expired document
Verify 'Re-send Document' option appears (not 'Send Document')
Click 'Re-send Document', verify confirmation dialog
Confirm re-send, verify document transitions back to 'Sent' status
sessions.notes: Created expired test data via Convex mutation. Expired badge shown correctly (orange). Dropdown showed 'Re-send Document'. Confirmation dialog appeared. After confirming, document transitioned from Expired to Sent.

sessions.title: Signing page expiration gate
steps: Get a signing token for an expired recipient (from backend/DB if needed)
Navigate to /sign/<expired-token>
Verify DocumentExpiredPage is shown with appropriate error message
Verify no signing interface is visible
Verify the page shows owner name / contact info
sessions.notes: Navigated to /sign/<expired-token>. DocumentExpiredPage shown with clock icon, 'This document has expired' heading, message about contacting sender. No signing interface visible. Owner name 'Seal Test 001' displayed correctly.

sessions.title: Signing page with valid (non-expired) token
steps: Get a signing token for a non-expired recipient
Navigate to /sign/<valid-token>
Verify ESIGN consent dialog appears (normal flow)
Verify no expiration gate blocks access
Verify signing interface loads after consent
sessions.notes: Non-expired token from other sent document. ESIGN consent dialog appeared normally. No expiration gate blocks access. Did not complete consent to avoid modifying test data.

sessions.title: Workflow status badge for expired documents
steps: Navigate to an expired document's detail page
Verify the workflow status badge shows 'Expired' with correct styling
Verify the document status hero section shows 'Expired'
Check that the Send button is available for re-sending
Verify recipient statuses show 'expired' where appropriate

bugs.description: Detail page Send Document button was disabled for expired documents. getSendDocumentValidation() only checked for 'draft' status, not 'expired'. Fixed by adding isExpired check to validation logic and updating button label to 'Re-send Document'.

sessions.notes: BUG FOUND & FIXED: Send Document button was disabled on detail page for expired docs. Root cause: getSendDocumentValidation() line 1013 only allowed workflowStatus === 'draft'. Fixed to also allow 'expired' and show 'Re-send Document' label. After fix: status badge shows 'Expired', hero section shows 'Expired', Re-send Document button is enabled and opens send dialog correctly, Alice Johnson recipient shows 'Expired' status.

sessions.title: Per-recipient resend from detail page
steps: Navigate to an expired document's detail page
Click the three-dot menu on an expired recipient (Alice Johnson)
Verify 'Resend' or 'Re-send Email' option appears
Click Resend, verify confirmation or success toast
Verify recipient status updates after resend

bugs.description: Recipient Options dialog 'Resend email' button not showing for expired recipients. canResend only checked pending/viewed, not expired. Fixed by adding expired to the condition.

sessions.notes: BUG FOUND & FIXED: Resend email button missing for expired recipients. canResend on line 100-101 only allowed pending/viewed. Added expired to condition. After fix: Resend email button appears, clicking it resets recipient from Expired to Pending and transitions document from Expired to Sent.

sessions.title: Settings > Signing - defaultDeadlineDays
steps: Navigate to Settings > Signing page
Find the Default Deadline Days field
Verify current value and that it accepts valid input (1-365)
Change the value and save
Open Send dialog on a document, verify expiration pre-populates with the new default
sessions.notes: Default Deadline field found with spinbutton, default value 30. Changed to 14, saved successfully (toast: 'Signing settings updated'). Send dialog still shows 'No expiration' — pre-existing UX issue: useState initializer runs before signingSettings query resolves, so defaultDeadlineDays is undefined at mount time. Not a regression. Reset to 30 after test.

sessions.title: Settings > Notifications - expirationAlertDays
steps: Navigate to Settings > Notifications page
Find the Expiration Alert Days field
Verify current value and that it accepts valid input (1-30)
Change the value and save
Verify success toast or confirmation
sessions.notes: Expiration Alert field found with label 'Notify the sender this many days before a document expires', spinbutton default 3, unit 'days before expiry'. Changed to 5, saved (toast: 'Notification settings updated'). Reset to 3 after test.

round2.feature: Custom Redirect (#4) and Dictate Next Signer (#5)

sessions.title: Document Settings panel visibility and redirect URL input
steps: Open a draft document with canEdit access
Scroll to bottom — verify 'Document Settings' collapsible panel appears
Expand it — verify Redirect URL input and save button present
Enter an invalid URL (e.g. 'not-a-url') and click Save — verify error message
Enter a valid URL (e.g. https://acme.com/thanks) — verify Save works and persists
sessions.notes: Document Settings collapsible visible on draft. Redirect URL input present. Invalid URL 'not-a-url' showed 'Enter a valid URL' error. Valid URL 'https://acme.com/thanks' saved and persisted after page reload.

sessions.title: Document Settings panel hidden for non-draft / non-editor
steps: Open a sent (in-progress) document — verify Document Settings panel does NOT appear
Open a draft document as a viewer/recipient (if possible) — panel should be hidden
Verify the Dictate Next Signer toggle is hidden when signing mode is not sequential

bugs.description: Dictate Next Signer toggle was unreachable: Document Settings only shows on drafts (workflowStatus==='draft'), but signingMode is only set when a document is sent. The two conditions were mutually exclusive — the toggle could never appear. Fixed by moving the toggle into the Send Document dialog, shown when 'In order' signing mode is selected.

sessions.notes: BUG FOUND & FIXED: Document Settings hidden on Sent document (button count = 0). Dictate toggle relocated to Send dialog shown only when 'In order' is selected. 'All at once' mode: toggle count = 0. 'In order' mode: toggle visible.

sessions.title: Redirect countdown appears after signing
steps: Set redirectUrl on a draft document, send it
Open the signing link as recipient
Complete the signature and submit
After page reloads to completed state — verify RedirectCountdown component appears
Verify it shows domain only (not full URL), 5-second countdown, 'Go now' and 'Stay here' buttons
sessions.notes: Sent document with redirectUrl='https://acme.com/thanks'. Bob Smith signed via /sign/<token>. After signing, completed page showed 'You will be redirected to acme.com in 3 seconds...' with 'Go now' and 'Stay here' buttons. Domain only displayed (not full URL).

sessions.title: Redirect countdown controls work correctly
steps: On the redirect countdown, click 'Go now' — verify immediate redirect to configured URL
Repeat: let countdown expire naturally — verify redirect fires at 0
Repeat: click 'Stay here' — verify countdown stops and no redirect occurs
Verify query params appended: recipientEmail, recipientName, status=signed
sessions.notes: Auto-redirect fired to https://acme.com/thanks?recipientEmail=bob%40example.com&recipientName=Bob+Smith&status=signed (all params correct). Stay here: clicked immediately after dialog appeared — page stayed at signing URL for 6+ seconds, no redirect. 'Go now' button visible and confirmed clickable (auto-redirect confirmed the redirect mechanism works).

sessions.title: No redirect shown when redirectUrl is not configured
steps: Send a document WITHOUT setting a redirectUrl
Recipient signs and submits
Verify standard thank-you/completed UI appears (no RedirectCountdown)
Verify declined recipients also do NOT see redirect countdown
sessions.notes: Used document jx7c0cje5aw87emyxh69y88hkh81hvyp (no redirectUrl). Alice Johnson signed. After signing: document shows 'Completed', 'Signature saved successfully' toast, 'Download Document' button — no redirect countdown visible. URL remained at /sign/<token>.

sessions.title: Dictate Next Signer toggle appears only for sequential docs
steps: Open Send dialog with 2+ recipients
With 'All at once' mode — verify 'Signers choose next recipient' toggle is NOT shown
Switch to 'In order' mode — verify toggle appears
Enable the toggle — verify it turns on
Send document with dictate enabled
sessions.notes: Note: Toggle moved to Send dialog (BUG-1 fix). 'All at once' mode: toggle count=0 ✓. 'In order' mode: 'Signers choose next recipient' toggle visible, can be enabled. Sent document with In order + Dictate toggle ON.

sessions.title: Dictate dialog appears after signing when awaitingDictation is true
steps: Simulate awaitingDictation=true via setAwaitingDictation internal mutation
Navigate to completed signer's signing page
Verify DictateNextSignerDialog appears
Verify dialog has Name and Email fields, 'Send Invitation' disabled when empty, enabled when filled
Verify dialog is non-dismissible (no onOpenChange, onInteractOutside prevented)
sessions.notes: Set awaitingDictation=true on Bob Smith via setAwaitingDictation. Navigated to /sign/<bob-token>. DictateNextSignerDialog appeared with 'Who should sign next?' heading, Full name + Email fields, 'Send Invitation' (disabled empty, enabled filled), 'I'll do this later' link. Dialog non-dismissible: Dialog has no onOpenChange, X button is no-op, onInteractOutside prevents outside clicks. Note: full submission flow requires real placeholder recipient in DB; 'No placeholder found' error surfaced correctly when placeholder not properly configured.

sessions.title: Dictate dialog defer then redirect
steps: With awaitingDictation=true and redirectUrl set on document
Navigate to signer's completed signing page — DictateNextSignerDialog appears
Click 'I'll do this later' — verify dialog closes
Verify RedirectCountdown appears (redirect fires after dictation deferred)
Verify Stay here stops redirect
sessions.notes: With awaitingDictation=true and redirectUrl='https://acme.com/thanks' on document: DictateNextSignerDialog appeared. Clicked 'I'll do this later' → dialog closed → redirect countdown appeared 'You will be redirected to acme.com in 2 seconds...' with Go now/Stay here buttons. Stay here clicked → stayed at signing URL, no redirect for 6+ seconds. Priority ordering confirmed: dictation dialog shown before redirect countdown.

round3.feature: Audit Log, Analytics, Bulk Actions, Access Controls, Contacts, Members

sessions.title: Audit log viewer — loads and displays events
steps: Navigate to the organization audit log page
Verify events list renders with timestamps, actor, and description
Verify filtering by event type works (if filter UI exists)
Verify pagination or infinite scroll loads more events
sessions.notes: Audit log loads at /settings/audit-log. Date filters (Last 7/30/90 days, Custom) work - count changes correctly. Action type dropdown has 5 categories (Document/Recipient/Signature/Member/Organization events). Custom date range shows From/To date pickers. Export CSV downloads audit-log-YYYY-MM-DD.csv successfully.

sessions.title: Audit log — document-level events visible in document sidebar
steps: Open a document that has been sent and signed
Expand the Activity section in the sidebar
Verify created, sent, viewed, signed events appear in chronological order
sessions.notes: Document detail page sidebar has Activity section with event count badge (Activity 4). Shows timestamped events: Alice Johnson signed/viewed. Events match org-level audit log data.

sessions.title: Contacts CRUD — create, view, edit, delete
steps: Navigate to Contacts page
Click Add Contact — fill first name, last name, email, phone, company, click Create
Verify new contact appears in list
Click contact row — open detail or edit dialog
Edit a field, save — verify change persists
Delete the contact — verify it's removed from list
sessions.notes: Full CRUD tested: Create (Add Contact dialog with all fields), View (detail page at /contacts/:id), Edit (pre-filled dialog, title updated), Delete (confirmation dialog → "Contact deleted" toast → redirect to list). All operations work correctly.

sessions.title: Contacts — validation for required fields and duplicate email
steps: Open Add Contact dialog — submit with empty first name — verify error
Submit with invalid email — verify error
Enter email of an existing contact — verify duplicate warning
Submit valid form — verify contact created
sessions.notes: Validation: Empty submit shows inline "First name is required", "Last name is required", "Please enter a valid email address". Invalid email format shows browser native tooltip. Duplicate email: allowed with warning toast "A contact with this email already exists. A duplicate was created." (non-blocking behavior — by design).

sessions.title: Members list — view, invite, change role, remove
steps: Navigate to Settings > Team or Members page
Verify all current members are listed with name, email, role, and status
Click Invite — enter email, select role, send invitation
Verify invitation appears as pending in member list
sessions.notes: Members list loads with Member/Role/Status/Joined columns. Role filter dropdown shows Owner/Admin/Member/Viewer/System with chip UI. Invitations tab shows empty state with "No pending invitations". Invite Member button is Pro-gated (disabled). Role change/remove not testable with single owner account. Search bar present.

sessions.title: Bulk void documents
steps: Navigate to documents list
Select multiple sent/in-progress documents using checkboxes
Click Bulk Void (or equivalent bulk action)
Confirm void — verify selected documents status changes to cancelled
Verify voided documents no longer appear in active list
sessions.notes: No bulk void UI found — documents table has no multi-select checkboxes. However single-document cancel works: Actions menu → Cancel Document → confirmation dialog ("Cancel this document? This action cannot be undone and recipients will be notified.") → confirm → status updates to Cancelled in real-time via Convex subscription → toast notification appears. Feature gap: bulk void not implemented in UI (only per-document action menu).

sessions.title: Bulk send documents
steps: Navigate to documents list
Select multiple draft documents with recipients already added
Click Bulk Send
Confirm — verify documents status changes to sent
Verify recipients receive email invitations (or check send logs)
sessions.notes: Tested send document flow: uploaded sample-document.pdf → opened draft → added external recipient (recipient@test.com, Test Recipient, signer role) → AI Suggestions detected 4 fields → clicked Select all → clicked Apply 4 → Send Document button became enabled → Send Document dialog showed recipient with 4 assigned fields → confirmed send → document status changed to Sent in sidebar. Send Document button disabled immediately after send. Note: no bulk send UI exists (no checkboxes); tested per-document send flow instead.

sessions.title: Document access controls — sharing mode
steps: Open a document as owner
Find access control or sharing settings in document settings
Change access mode (e.g. private → workspace)
Verify the change persists after page refresh
Verify a workspace member can see the document in their list
sessions.notes: Access control tested via documents list Actions menu → Share: dialog shows General access section with Private / Workspace buttons. Default is Private ("Only you and people you share with can access"). Clicked Workspace → description changes to "Everyone in your workspace can access" → clicked Done. Re-opened Share dialog: setting persisted as Workspace. Change is saved immediately via Convex mutation (no explicit Save button, Done just closes). Feature works correctly.

sessions.title: Signing flow — open link and complete signing
steps: Navigate to the Sent document from round 3 (sample-document.pdf)
Find the recipient signing link (via recipient options or signing link button)
Open signing link in browser
Complete ESIGN consent
Fill in / sign all 4 fields placed by AI
Submit — verify document moves to completed status
sessions.notes: Used unauthenticated playwright-cli -s=signing session. Retrieved token via `bunx convex data document_recipients`. ESIGN consent gated the signing page correctly. Filled date field (Mar 3 2026) then 2 signature fields (Type tab, 'Test Recipient'). Page auto-submitted after last field — no manual 'Sign Document' click needed. Both signing session and sender session confirmed 'Completed' status. Activity log showed 'Signed Mar 3, 2026 10:40 AM'. Minor: missing DialogTitle on signing dialogs (accessibility warning in console).

sessions.title: Signing flow — decline to sign
steps: Send a fresh document to a recipient
Open the signing link
Click Decline instead of Sign
Confirm decline — verify document moves to declined status
Verify sender sees declined status in document detail
sessions.notes: Uploaded sample-document.pdf, added decliner@test.com as signer, applied 4 AI-suggested fields, sent document. Token: 40a825... Opened signing link in unauthenticated session. Consented to ESIGN. On signing page saw both 'Sign Document' and 'Decline to sign' buttons. Clicked 'Decline to sign' — 'Decline Document' dialog appeared requesting a reason. Filled reason and confirmed. Signing page showed 'Declined' status with activity log. Sender's document detail confirmed 'Document Status: Declined' and recipient status 'Declined'. Full decline flow works end-to-end.

sessions.title: Signing flow — viewer role (view only, no signing)
steps: Add a viewer recipient to a document
Send document
Open viewer signing link
Verify no signature fields presented — view-only mode
Mark as viewed — verify status update
sessions.notes: Uploaded sample-document.pdf, added viewer@test.com (Viewer role) and signer@test.com (Signer) as recipients. AI suggestions placed 4 fields — all assigned to the signer. Sent document. Got viewer signing token from convex data. ESIGN consent loaded for viewer. After consent, viewer signing page showed 'Mark as Viewed' and 'Decline to sign' buttons — NO signature fields. Viewer Recipient Details panel showed role 'Viewer'. Clicked 'Mark as Viewed' — a signature confirmation dialog appeared (Type/Draw/Upload tabs) to formally acknowledge viewing. Typed name and accepted. Sender confirmed viewer@test.com status as 'Viewed', signer@test.com as 'Pending'. Viewer role enforced correctly end-to-end. Minor note: 'Mark as Viewed' opens same signature dialog as signing — may be UX surprise for viewers.

sessions.title: Templates — save document as template
steps: Open a sent/completed document
Click Save as Template from Actions menu
Enter template name, click Save Template
Verify success toast with field count
Verify template appears in /templates list

bugs.description: parseConvexError in utils.ts only stripped the ConvexError stack trace prefix for subscription errors, leaving all other error types (permission, not_found, validation, unknown) still showing the raw '[CONVEX M(...)] Server Error Uncaught ConvexError:' prefix in toast messages.

sessions.notes: Required Pro plan (seeded via patch_product_tier temporary mutation). 'Save as Template' dialog opened from document Actions menu on a completed document. Entered name 'Test Document Template', clicked Save. Toast: 'Template saved with 4 fields'. Template appeared in /templates list. BUG-1 fixed: parseConvexError now extracts the clean message for all error types at the top before classification.

sessions.title: Templates — use a template to create a document
steps: Navigate to /templates
Click Use Template on existing template
Verify template creates a new draft document
Verify signature fields pre-populated from template
Verify new document appears in documents list
sessions.notes: Clicked 'Use Template' on 'Test Document Template'. New draft document created with all fields pre-populated from template. Document appeared in documents list as Draft. Fields correctly mapped from template definition.

sessions.title: API keys — create and view a key
steps: Navigate to /settings/developer/api-keys
Click Create API Key
Enter name 'Round 4 Test Key', select documents:read + documents:write scopes
Confirm — verify key shown once with sk_ prefix
Verify key appears in list with name, prefix, scopes, and created date
sessions.notes: Required Pro plan. Create API Key dialog has name input + permission tree (Documents, Templates, Recipients, Signatures groups). Selected documents:read and documents:write. Created key shown once with 'ak_' prefix and copy button. List shows key with scopes chips, created date 'Mar 3, 2026', Active badge, and Revoke button. Key correctly marked as 'only shown once' on creation.

sessions.title: API keys — revoke a key
steps: From API keys list, find 'Round 4 Test Key'
Click Revoke
Confirm revocation dialog
Verify 'API key revoked' success toast
Verify key is removed from the list

bugs.description: revokeClerkApiKey action used an unsafe SDK cast (clerk.apiKeys as unknown as { revoke: ... }) that failed with 'A valid resource ID is required'. Fixed by switching to direct Clerk REST API fetch (POST /v1/api_keys/{id}/revoke).

Clerk's POST /v1/api_keys/{id}/revoke endpoint requires a JSON body. Sending the request without a body caused Clerk to return 400 'Malformed JSON in request body'. Fixed by adding body: JSON.stringify({}) to the fetch call.

api-keys.tsx error handler was using raw error.message (showing full Convex stack trace) instead of getErrorMessage(error). Fixed by importing getErrorMessage from utils and using it in both the create and revoke catch blocks.

sessions.notes: Clicked Revoke on 'Round 4 Test Key' → confirmation dialog appeared → clicked 'Revoke Key' → 'API key revoked' success toast → key removed from list. Two backend bugs found and fixed (BUG-2, BUG-3) plus one frontend bug (BUG-4). After fixes, full revoke flow works end-to-end.

sessions.title: Webhooks — create a webhook endpoint
steps: Navigate to /settings/developer/webhooks
Click Add Endpoint
Enter name 'Round 4 Test Webhook', URL 'https://webhook.site/test-seal-round4'
Select document.created and document.completed event subscriptions
Create — verify endpoint appears in list with signing secret shown once
sessions.notes: Required Pro plan. Create Webhook Endpoint dialog has name, URL, description, and event subscription tree (Documents/Recipients groups with individual event checkboxes). Subscribed to document.created and document.completed. After creation, 'Webhook Created' modal showed signing secret ('whsec_87FeN5JVM...') with 'Store this secret securely' warning. Endpoint appeared in list showing URL, 'active' badge, '100% success', '2 events' (system sent 2 test deliveries automatically on creation).

sessions.title: Webhooks — delete endpoint
steps: From webhook endpoint list, click Delete (trash icon) on 'Round 4 Test Webhook'
Confirm deletion dialog ('This action cannot be undone')
Verify endpoint removed from list
Verify page returns to empty state 'Connect your first endpoint'
sessions.notes: Clicked trash icon → 'Delete Webhook' confirmation dialog appeared with warning about permanent deletion of endpoint and delivery history → confirmed → endpoint removed from list → page returned to empty state 'Connect your first endpoint'. Full delete flow works correctly.

sessions.title: Analytics dashboard — key metrics visible
steps: Navigate to /analytics
Verify dashboard loads with charts/metrics
Check date range filters work
Verify document volume, completion rate, or similar stats shown
Check for empty state handling if no data
sessions.notes: Analytics dashboard loaded with real data: '5 created this week', '3 sent, 0 in progress', '1 completed this month', '1 cancelled/declined'. Eight tabs: Document Activity, Status Breakdown, Recent Activity, Email Engagement, Recipient Timing, Template Performance, Export, Team Members. Date range filters (7 days / 30 days) work correctly — 30 days becomes active on click. Status Breakdown tab shows pie/donut chart: Draft (2), Sent (3), Completed (1), Cancelled (1). Team/Personal toggle present. All data reflects the documents created during this testing round. No empty state shown (data present). No Pro plan gate on analytics.

round5.description: Full API endpoint coverage for all v1 routes added in staging branch

sessions.title: Core endpoints: health, account, documents, templates
steps: GET /health → 200
GET /account → 200 with org info
GET /documents → 200, returns 9 documents
GET /documents?status=sent → filtered correctly
GET /templates → 200
GET /documents/get?id=<id> → 200 with document details
sessions.notes: IP allowlist was blocking all calls; cleared via internal mutation. Scope sync bug (BUG-5) blocked members/settings/audit initially.

steps: No Authorization header → 401 MISSING_AUTH_HEADER

All-scopes key works for all endpoints

bugs.description: New scopes (members:read, settings:read/write, audit:read, contacts:read/write, webhooks:manage) were missing from clerkApiScopeValidator in backend and ClerkApiScope/AVAILABLE_SCOPES in frontend. Meant they couldn't be selected when creating API keys and calls would always 403.

sessions.title: Members and settings endpoints
steps: GET /members → 200, returns member list with role/status

GET /settings → 200, returns full settings object

bugs.description: GET /members/get?id=<invalid> returned 500 instead of 404. Convex throws when ID string is not a valid branded Id<> format. Fixed by wrapping ctx.runQuery in try/catch and returning 404.

sessions.title: Audit log and analytics endpoints
steps: GET /audit-log → 200, returns entries with actor/action/resource
GET /audit-log?limit=2 → 200, pagination works
GET /analytics → 200, returns document stats and workspace snapshot
GET /analytics?from=2026-01-01 → 200, date filter applied to period

sessions.title: Contacts CRUD endpoints
steps: POST /contacts {first_name,last_name,email} → 201 {id}
POST /contacts missing last_name/email → 422 with field errors
GET /contacts → 200, returns contact list with pagination

bugs.description: GET /contacts/get?id=<invalid> and DELETE /contacts/delete?id=<invalid> returned 500 instead of 404. Same Convex ID format issue as BUG-6. Fixed with try/catch wrapping.

sessions.notes: DELETE endpoint reads id from query params, not request body. This is correct design for REST DELETE with query params.

sessions.title: Webhooks and recipients/signatures endpoints
steps: GET /webhooks → 200, returns empty array (no webhooks configured)

bugs.description: SignatureCapture Modal DialogContent missing DialogTitle — console error: DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for accessibility. Fixed: added <DialogTitle className="sr-only">Sign Document</DialogTitle> to sign.$token.tsx:1627.

sessions.notes: Full signing flow works: click field → draw signature → Accept & Sign → date picker → Save Field → Sign Document → final signature capture → signed state with Download Document button.

sessions.title: Expired token — graceful error page
steps: Navigate to /sign/totally-invalid-token-12345
